title: $τ_0$-VLA: a Hierarchical Robot Foundation Model with World-Model-Guided Test-Time Computation
summary: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires a robot to both execute individual skills reliably and sequence them coherently over extended tasks. Most hierarchical vision-language-action (VLA) models make each such decision with a single forward pass, leaving no mechanism to allocate additional computation to difficult or consequential choices. We introduce $τ_0$-VLA, a hierarchical robot foundation model that formulates high-level subtask generation as a compute-scalable inference problem through world-model-guided test-time computation. At each inference step, the high-level policy uses execution memory to generate a subtask and, when needed, searches over alternatives before committing to its output. A low-level policy then executes the generated subtask across multiple robot embodiments. The policy is trained on 40,115 hours of heterogeneous real-world data with multimodal co-training. Across in-domain and distribution-shifted settings, allocating additional test-time computation substantially improves next-subtask prediction accuracy, and these gains translate into higher closed-loop success on long-horizon robot manipulation tasks.
tldr: Tau0-VLA is a hierarchical robot foundation model that improves long-horizon manipulation by using a world model to guide test-time computation, allowing the high-level policy to search over subtask alternatives for better accuracy and closed-loop success.
tldr_zh: Tau0-VLA是一种分层机器人基础模型，通过世界模型引导测试时计算，使高层策略能搜索子任务替代方案，从而提升长周期操作的成功率。
summary_zh: 长时域机器人操作要求机器人既能可靠地执行单个技能，又能将技能在长时间任务中连贯地序列化组合。大多数层次化视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过单次前向传递做出每一个决策，缺乏为困难或关键选择分配额外计算量的机制。我们提出$τ_0$-VLA，一种层次化机器人基础模型，将高层子任务生成公式化为通过世界模型引导的测试时计算实现的可扩展推理问题。在每次推理步骤中，高层策略利用执行记忆生成子任务，并在必要时搜索替代方案后确定输出。随后，低层策略跨多种机器人本体执行生成的子任务。该策略在40,115小时异构真实世界数据上通过多模态协同训练进行训练。在领域内和分布偏移场景下，分配额外的测试时计算能显著提升下一子任务预测精度，这些增益进一步转化为长时域机器人操作任务中更高的闭环成功率。

title: RoboStriker: Latent-Space Strategic Games for Autonomous Humanoid Boxing
summary: Achieving human-level competitive intelligence and physical agility in humanoid robots remains a profound challenge, particularly in contact-rich and highly dynamic tasks such as boxing. While Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning offers a principled framework for strategic interaction, its direct application to unstructured raw motor spaces inevitably leads to joint-level physical collapse, preventing the emergence of any viable combat tactics. To resolve this fundamental conflict between strategic exploration and physical feasibility, we formulate the humanoid combat task as a novel two-player latent-space zero-sum Markov game. Under standard regularity and approximate best-response assumptions, we show that the latent formulation induces an equivalent game over the decoder-reachable action manifold, providing an approximate-Nash interpretation of the resulting self-play dynamics. To instantiate this theoretical formulation, we propose RoboStriker, a hierarchical framework that decouples high-level reasoning from low-level execution. It first distills the tracking expertise of predefined boxing motions into a topologically bounded latent manifold. This structured latent foundation subsequently drives multi-agent co-evolution via Latent-Space Neural Fictitious Self-Play. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that gaming within this structured latent space substantially outperforms direct exploration. By constraining strategic exploration through a pretrained motion decoder, RoboStriker substantially reduces the catastrophic balance failures observed in raw action-space methods and achieves superior tactical performance in both competitive win rates and striking efficiency. Finally, we successfully deploy and validate our learned combat policies on real-world humanoid robots. Our code and video and supplementary materials are available at RoboStriker.
tldr: RoboStriker presents a hierarchical framework for humanoid boxing that decouples high-level strategic reasoning from low-level motion execution by formulating combat as a latent-space zero-sum Markov game, enabling multi-agent self-play within a bounded motion manifold to avoid physical collapse, and demonstrates real-world deployment.
tldr_zh: RoboStriker 提出了一种用于人形机器人拳击的分层框架，通过将战斗任务建模为潜在空间零和马尔可夫博弈，将高层战略推理与底层运动执行分离，在预定义运动流形内进行多智能体自博弈以避免物理崩溃，并实现了真实机器人部署。
summary_zh: 在仿人机器人中实现人类级别的竞技智能与身体敏捷性仍是一项重大挑战，尤其在拳击这类高接触、高动态的任务中。虽然多智能体强化学习为策略性交互提供了理论框架，但其直接应用于非结构化原始运动空间必然导致关节层面的物理崩溃，从而无法产生任何可行的搏击战术。为解决策略探索与物理可行性之间的根本矛盾，我们将仿人机器人搏击任务形式化为一种新颖的双人隐空间零和马尔可夫博弈。在标准正则性与近似最优响应假设下，我们证明隐空间形式化在解码器可达动作流形上诱导出等效博弈，从而对由此产生的自我对弈动力学提供了近似纳什均衡解释。为实例化这一理论框架，我们提出RoboStriker——一种将高层推理与低层执行解耦的层次化架构。该架构首先将预定义拳击动作的跟踪专业知识蒸馏至拓扑有界隐流形中，随后通过隐空间神经虚拟自我对弈驱动多智能体协同演化。大量实验结果表明，在此结构化隐空间内进行博弈显著优于直接探索。通过经由预训练运动解码器约束策略探索，RoboStriker大幅减少了原始动作空间方法中常见的灾难性平衡失效，并在竞技胜率与攻击效率两方面均展现出卓越的战术性能。最终，我们在真实仿人机器人上成功部署并验证了所学搏击策略。相关代码、视频及补充材料见RoboStriker。

title: SparkVLA: Stop-Aware Hierarchical VLA with Adaptive Action Chunking for Long-Horizon Manipulation
summary: At every re-observation point in a hierarchical Vision-Language-Action (VLA) system, two interface decisions must be made: when to terminate the current subtask and how far to execute the proposed action chunk. These decisions are mutually dependent---the optimal stopping point depends on what the executor plans to do, while the optimal execution length depends on where the subtask boundary lies---yet existing architectures evaluate them in isolation, an asymmetry neither module can overcome alone. We present SparkVLA, a stop-aware hierarchical VLA that resolves this mutual dependency by formulating both decisions as a single ranking: Stop competes against every action-prefix length in a unified candidate set, and the system selects the highest-scoring option, eliminating threshold tuning and requiring only offline ordinal preferences. An Anchor-Conditioned Context Encoding module caches a history-aware subtask anchor encoding onset-state memory and goal semantics, guiding visual-token pruning toward task-relevant regions; a Stop-Aware Action-Prefix Selection head scores all candidates via full self bnattention at chunk boundaries for efficiency. On RoboCerebra, SparkVLA achieves 47.12% success rate, surpassing the official hierarchical baseline by 30.57% and the strongest reproducible method by 26.83% Real-robot experiments on multi-step tasks further validate these gains on physical hardware.
tldr: SparkVLA introduces a stop-aware hierarchical VLA that jointly decides subtask termination and action chunk length via a unified ranking mechanism, enabling effective long-horizon manipulation.
tldr_zh: SparkVLA 提出了一种具有停止感知的分层 VLA，通过统一的排序机制联合决定子任务终止和动作块长度，从而实现了有效的长时域操作。
summary_zh: 在层级式视觉-语言-动作（VLA）系统的每个重观测点，必须做出两个接口决策：何时终止当前子任务，以及执行到所提议动作块的何种程度。这两个决策相互依赖——最优停止点取决于执行器的计划内容，而最优执行长度又取决于子任务的边界所在——但现有体系结构却孤立地评估它们，这种非对称性使得任一模块都无法单独克服。我们提出SparkVLA，一种具有停止感知能力的层级式VLA，通过将两个决策统一为单一排序来解决这一相互依赖问题：在统一候选集中，停止选项与每个动作前缀长度竞争，系统选择得分最高的选项，从而无需阈值调优，仅需离线排序偏好。锚点条件上下文编码模块缓存具有历史感知能力的子任务锚点编码，包含状态起始记忆与目标语义，引导视觉标记剪枝朝向任务相关区域；停止感知动作前缀选择头在块边界处通过全自注意力对所有候选进行评分以提高效率。在RoboCerebra上，SparkVLA实现了47.12%的成功率，超过官方层级基线30.57%，超过最强可复现方法26.83%。在多步骤任务的真实机器人实验中，这些优势在物理硬件上得到了进一步验证。

title: Unified Condition-Action Modeling for Accurate One-Step Action Generation
summary: Robot manipulation requires policies that are both accurate and efficient, as robot control must respond to changing observations under tight latency constraints. Recent diffusion and flow policies are promising, but they often treat conditions as auxiliary signals rather than jointly evolving them with action trajectories. We find that this limitation can be effectively mitigated by a \textbf{simple yet effective unified condition-action modeling design} that represents conditions and actions in a shared token space, allowing a compact model to achieve high performance while improving both inference speed and accuracy. Therefore, we propose UCA-Flow, a unified condition-action modeling framework for accurate one-step action generation. Our method unifies observation conditions, timestep conditions, interval conditions, and action tokens into a single sequence, and processes them with a Unified Condition-Action Transformer for joint condition-action representation learning. As a result, condition representations are dynamically reconstructed according to the current generation stage, highlighting information most relevant for action refinement. Furthermore, we introduce an improved dual-pass supervision scheme over $u$ and $v$ for stronger optimization of unified condition-action modeling. UCA-Flow improves the average success rate by 9.3 percentage points over the strongest baseline, while achieving $45.6\times$ and $33.4\times$ speedups over DP3 and Simple DP3, and remaining $4.3\times$ and $2.3\times$ faster than one-step FlowPolicy and MP1, respectively.
tldr: UCA-Flow unifies condition and action tokens into a shared sequence with a single transformer, enabling accurate one-step action generation for robot manipulation with large speedups over diffusion policies.
tldr_zh: UCA-Flow 将条件与动作令牌统一到共享序列中，通过单一变压器实现精准的一步动作生成，并大幅超越扩散策略的速度。
summary_zh: 机器人操控需要兼具精确性与高效性的策略，因为机器人控制必须在严格的延迟限制下对不断变化的观测作出响应。近年来扩散策略与流策略虽展现出潜力，但往往将条件视为辅助信号，而非使其与动作轨迹共同演化。我们发现，这一局限可通过一种**简洁而有效的统一条件-动作建模设计**得到有效缓解——该设计将条件与动作表征至共享的令牌空间，使紧凑模型在提升推理速度与精度的同时实现高性能。为此，我们提出UCA-Flow——一种用于精确单步动作生成的统一条件-动作建模框架。该方法将观测条件、时间步条件、间隔条件与动作令牌统一纳入单一序列，并通过统一条件-动作Transformer进行处理，实现条件与动作的联合表征学习。由此，条件表征可根据当前生成阶段动态重构，突出与动作优化最相关的信息。此外，我们引入改进的$u$与$v$双路监督方案，以强化统一条件-动作建模的优化效果。UCA-Flow相较于最强基线将平均成功率提升9.3个百分点，同时实现较DP3与Simple DP3分别达$45.6\times$与$33.4\times$的加速，并较单步FlowPolicy与MP1分别保持$4.3\times$与$2.3\times$的速度优势。

title: Don't Drop the BATON: Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation via Agentic Subtask Exploration and Transition-aware Memory
summary: Long-horizon robot manipulation chains many contact-rich skills into one multi-stage task. Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly master the individual skills, yet the chain still fails: errors compound beyond the policy's ability to correct, and one subtask silently constrains the next. A promising recipe freezes the VLA and puts an LLM agent in charge: it plans in language, moves in free space with analytic primitives, invokes the VLA only for contact-rich segments, and writes adaptation into language memory. Applied to long horizons, it breaks twice. (1) Competence comes from whole-task exploration at test time, whose cost is multiplicative in stages: if one stage needs T episodes, a K-stage task needs about T^K, and a failure does not reveal which stage caused it. (2) It has no representation of transitions: the VLA primitive carries an exit but no entry condition, so a subtask can succeed in a form its successor cannot use. We present BATON. Against (1), BATON makes the subtask the unit of exploration: each is explored in the cheap short-horizon regime and its solution stored in memory; a long-horizon trajectory is then composed from these solutions rather than discovered whole. Cost becomes additive (T*K) and every failure is attributed to a single stage. Against (2), BATON equips exploration with a transition-aware memory. Within a subtask, a verifier agent governs the invocation transition: the VLA is called only after the wrist view confirms the scene is ready. Across subtasks, a handoff transition restores an entry state disturbed by the predecessor's residue, and a lookahead transition selects the strategy whose outcome the successor can inherit. No parameters are updated. On the long-horizon benchmark RoboMemArena, BATON improves task success by 11.6% and cumulative success by 14.9% over the SoTA.
tldr: BATON decomposes long-horizon manipulation into cheap subtask exploration with transition-aware memory, achieving additive cost and 11.6% success improvement over SoTA.
tldr_zh: BATON 将长时域操作分解为低成本的子任务探索，并引入过渡感知记忆，实现成本累加，任务成功率比当前最优方法高 11.6%。
summary_zh: 长时域机器人操作将多个接触密集型技能串联成一项多阶段任务。视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型日益擅长掌握单个技能，但整体链条仍会失败：误差累积超出策略的修正能力，且某个子任务会无声地制约后续任务。一种有前景的方案是冻结VLA，由大语言模型（LLM）智能体负责全局调度：它以语言规划，通过解析基元在自由空间中移动，仅在接触密集型环节调用VLA，并将适应性调整写入语言记忆。然而，应用于长时域场景时，该方法会在两方面失效。（1）能力依赖于测试时的全任务探索，其代价随阶段数呈乘法增长：若某阶段需T轮探索，K阶段任务需约T^K轮，且一次失败无法揭示由哪个阶段导致。（2）缺乏对过渡状态的表征：VLA基元虽有退出条件但无进入条件，导致子任务可能以后续任务无法利用的形式成功。我们提出BATON方法。针对问题（1），BATON以子任务为探索单元：每个子任务在低代价的短时域模式下探索，其解决方案存储于记忆库；长时域轨迹由这些解决方案组合而成，而非整体发现。探索代价转为加法增长（T*K），且每次失败可归因于单个阶段。针对问题（2），BATON为探索配备过渡感知记忆。在子任务内部，验证器智能体管控调用过渡：仅当腕部相机视图确认场景就绪后，才调用VLA。在子任务间，交接过渡会恢复被前序任务残留干扰的入口状态，前瞻过渡则选择其结果能被后续任务继承的策略。所有参数均不作更新。在长时域基准测试RoboMemArena上，BATON将任务成功率提升11.6%，累计成功率较当前最优方法提升14.9%。

title: VLCP: Vision Language Control Policy Closed-Loop Code Replanning for Robot Manipulation
summary:
Turning a frontier vision-language model into a robot policy usually means fine-tuning it to emit an action representation it never saw in pretraining, which throws away much of the reasoning that made the model worth reaching for. We go the other way and keep the VLM frozen. It writes the policy as a short Python control function, with no demonstrations and no fine-tuning. Writing that code once is open-loop, though. Existing closed-loop methods react at the wrong level: they retry a fixed policy or pick a different subtask, but never rewrite the code that failed. VLCP closes the loop where the failure actually lives, on the control code, within a single episode. Every $K$ steps the VLM re-observes the scene from multi-view RGB, proprioceptive state, and a state delta, then rewrites the control function from what it just saw, so a failure is caught before it compounds.
  We evaluate on a 57-task MuJoCo/RoboVerse sweep. This training-free policy reaches $35.1\%$ pooled success, against $3.5\%$ for the identical system queried once per episode. That tenfold gap holds with non-overlapping confidence intervals in every scene family. The gain traces to a $27.3\%$ within-episode recovery rate on failed grasps: a miss an open-loop controller would carry to the end of the episode gets re-observed and fixed at the next replan. And the loop stays cheap. A median $84\%$ of input tokens hit cache, an episode needs only about $10$ compact queries, and control blocks written during any replan persist to a cross-episode skill library reused in later prompts.
tldr: VLCP freezes a VLM and uses it to write Python control functions that are periodically rewritten within an episode based on multi-view observations, achieving training-free robot manipulation with a 27.3% recovery rate on failed grasps and a 10x success gain over open-loop baselines.
tldr_zh: VLCP冻结视觉语言模型，通过让它编写Python控制函数并在每个回合内根据多视角观测定期重写这些函数，实现了无需训练的机器人操作，失败抓取恢复率达27.3%，成功率比开环基线提升10倍。
summary_zh:
将前沿的视觉-语言模型转化为机器人策略，通常意味着需要微调模型，使其输出在预训练阶段从未见过的动作表征，这浪费了模型本身值得采用的推理能力。我们反其道而行之，保持视觉-语言模型冻结不变。它只需编写一段简短的Python控制函数作为策略，无需任何示范数据或微调。然而，一次性编写该代码属于开环方式。现有的闭环方法在错误的层级进行响应：它们要么重试固定策略，要么选择不同的子任务，但从不重写导致失败的那段代码。VLCP在失败实际发生的层级——即控制代码层面——在单个任务回合内实现闭环。每经过K个步骤，视觉-语言模型会从多视角RGB图像、本体感知状态以及状态变化量中重新观察场景，然后根据刚观察到的情况重写控制函数，从而在失败累积之前及时捕获并修正。  
我们在包含57个任务的MuJoCo/RoboVerse基准测试上进行评估。这种无需训练的策略实现了35.1%的总体成功率，而每个回合仅查询一次模型的相同系统成功率仅为3.5%。这一十倍差距在每一个场景族中均具有非重叠置信区间。性能提升归因于抓取失败时27.3%的回合内恢复率：开环控制器会将一次失误一直延续到回合结束，而我们的方法能在下一次重规划时重新观察并修正。同时，闭环成本保持低廉。中位数84%的输入令牌命中缓存，每个回合仅需约10次紧凑查询，并且任何重规划期间生成的控制代码块会持久化到跨回合技能库中，供后续提示词复用。

title: HAF: Adapting Generalist VLAs to Humanoid Whole-Body Loco-manipulation via Hierarchical Action Flow and Spectral Latent RL
summary: Humanoid robots hold great promise as general-purpose agents in human-centered environments, yet generalist vision-language-action (VLA) foundation models are not readily applicable to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation. The high dimensionality and interdependence of humanoid motions make it challenging for conventional single-stage VLA architectures to coordinate locomotion, waist posture, and dual-arm manipulation effectively. Moreover, policies trained through offline behavior cloning can remain suboptimal during real-world deployment. Although online reinforcement learning can refine policies through real-world interaction, directly tuning large VLA backbones demands excessive computation and may introduce safety risks during real-robot exploration. To address these bottlenecks, we introduce HAF (Humanoid Adaptation Framework), a two-part framework consisting of HAF-VLA and HAF-Steer that transfers off-the-shelf generalist VLA foundation models to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation. HAF-VLA is a hierarchical action-flow generator built on a pretrained flow-matching VLA. It splits full-body action denoising into three sequential stages with stage embeddings and cross-stage KV caches that retain kinematic dependencies, avoiding incoherent whole-body actions from one-shot generation. On top of the frozen HAF-VLA, HAF-Steer is a latent offline-to-online RL pipeline that leverages flow-matching invertibility and DCT-based dimensionality reduction to restrict RL optimization to a compact noise subspace and train a regularized SAC policy. This avoids updating the large VLA backbone and enables efficient real-world policy refinement. Evaluated on seven real-world humanoid loco-manipulation tasks, HAF surpasses vanilla single-stage VLA baselines and improves whole-body coordination and task performance. Project website: https://grange007.github.io/HAF .
tldr: HAF proposes a hierarchical action-flow generator (HAF-VLA) and a latent offline-to-online RL pipeline (HAF-Steer) to adapt generalist vision-language-action models to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation, achieving improved coordination and task performance on real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: HAF 提出了分层动作流生成器 (HAF-VLA) 和潜在离线到在线强化学习管道 (HAF-Steer)，将通用视觉-语言-动作模型适配到人形机器人全身移动操作，在真实世界任务中提升了协调性和任务表现。
summary_zh: 类人机器人有望成为以人为中心的环境中的通用智能体，但通用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）基础模型难以直接适用于类人全身移动操控任务。类人动作的高维度和强耦合性使得传统单阶段VLA架构难以有效协调运动、腰部姿态与双臂操控。此外，通过离线行为克隆训练的策略在实际部署中仍可能表现次优。虽然在线强化学习可通过真实环境交互优化策略，但直接微调大型VLA主干网络需要大量计算资源，且在真实机器人探索过程中可能引入安全风险。为解决上述瓶颈，我们提出HAF（Humanoid Adaptation Framework）双组件框架，包含HAF-VLA与HAF-Steer，旨在将现成的通用VLA基础模型迁移至类人全身移动操控任务。HAF-VLA是基于预训练流匹配VLA的分层动作流生成器，通过阶段嵌入与保留运动学依赖的跨阶段KV缓存，将全身动作去噪分解为三个连续阶段，避免了一次性生成导致的全身动作不协调。基于冻结的HAF-VLA，HAF-Steer构建了从离线到在线的潜在空间强化学习流水线，利用流匹配可逆性与基于DCT的降维技术，将强化学习优化限制在紧凑噪声子空间内，并训练正则化SAC策略。该方法避免更新大型VLA主干网络，实现了高效的真实世界策略优化。在七个真实世界类人移动操控任务上的评估表明，HAF优于标准单阶段VLA基线，显著提升了全身协调性与任务性能。项目网站：https://grange007.github.io/HAF

title: Neurosymbolic Embodied Agents
summary: Language and vision-language models generate plausible embodied plans but do not guarantee executability, as their outputs can violate environment dynamics or act on incorrectly grounded entities. We present a neurosymbolic agent that factors long-horizon household tasks into task-directed visual exploration and constrained symbolic planning. In the first phase, a vision-language model and exploration harness acquire goal-relevant predicates and instance bindings from egocentric observations and grounded interactions, producing a symbolic initial state. In the second, a PDDL transition model restricts decoding to tokens that extend applicable actions. Monte Carlo tree search then evaluates executable continuations using a domain-independent planning heuristic. The resulting plans are executable by construction under the transition model, with transfer to the environment conditioned on correct visual grounding. On VirtualHome and ALFWorld, open 4B-27B models exceed 90% success in both environments, and our smallest agent substantially outperforms a 27B direct visual policy in each. Constraints and search prove complementary rather than interchangeable: in ALFWorld either alone solves under a third of tasks, whereas their combination solves over 95%. The method also uses several times fewer generated tokens than extended thinking and far fewer model-visible images than direct interaction, and residual failures localize to state acquisition rather than plan generation without any specialized training.
tldr: A neurosymbolic agent that combines vision-language models with symbolic planning to generate executable long-horizon household plans, achieving over 90% success on VirtualHome and ALFWorld.
tldr_zh: 一种神经符号智能体，结合视觉-语言模型与符号规划，生成可执行的长期家庭任务计划，在VirtualHome和ALFWorld上成功率超过90%。
summary_zh: 语言与视觉-语言模型能够生成看似合理的具身规划，但无法保证其可执行性，因为其输出可能违反环境动力学或作用于错误指称的实体。我们提出一种神经符号智能体，将长时域家庭任务分解为任务导向的视觉探索与约束符号规划。在第一阶段，视觉-语言模型与探索机制从第一人称观测和具身交互中获取与目标相关的谓词和实例绑定，生成符号化初始状态。在第二阶段，PDDL转移模型将解码限制为可扩展适用动作的词元。随后，蒙特卡洛树搜索利用领域无关的规划启发式评估可执行的延续序列。由此产生的规划在转移模型下天然可执行，且向真实环境的迁移依赖于正确的视觉指称。在VirtualHome和ALFWorld环境中，4B-27B参数规模的开源模型在两个环境中均达到超过90%的成功率，而我们的最小规模智能体在每个环境中均大幅超越27B参数的直接视觉策略。约束与搜索被证明是互补而非可互换的：在ALFWorld中，单独使用任一方法仅能解决不足三分之一的任任务，而两者结合可解决超过95%的任务。该方法生成的词元数比扩展推理少数倍，模型可见图像数比直接交互少得多，且剩余故障定位于状态获取而非规划生成，无需任何专门训练。

title: MatchingPolicy: Correspondence-Aware Policy Enables Cross-Object In-Context Learning
summary: In-context imitation learning enables few-shot policy generalization but struggles to maintain performance on unseen objects and novel scenarios. To address this, we introduce MatchingPolicy, a correspondence-driven framework that explicitly decouples demonstration-to-scene matching from policy learning. Central to our method is a correspondence-aware diffusion policy that conditions robotic actions directly on dense semantic correspondences. This architectural separation resolves the inherent conflict between correspondence identification and action adaptation, enabling robust out-of-distribution transfer. Our framework integrates vision foundation models with a novel two-stage matching algorithm to dynamically establish reliable correspondences. Extensive evaluations on RLBench and real-world manipulation tasks confirm that MatchingPolicy achieves superior few-shot performance, generalizing reliably across unseen object instances and semantic categories.
tldr: MatchingPolicy introduces a correspondence-aware diffusion policy that decouples scene-matching from action generation, enabling in-context imitation learning that generalizes to unseen objects and categories in both simulated (RLBench) and real-world manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: MatchingPolicy 提出了一种对应感知的扩散策略，将场景匹配与动作生成解耦，使得上下文模仿学习能够泛化到仿真（RLBench）和真实操作任务中未见过的物体和类别。
summary_zh: 基于上下文的模仿学习能够实现小样本策略泛化，但在面对未见物体和新场景时性能难以维持。为解决这一问题，我们提出MatchingPolicy——一种基于对应关系的框架，通过将示范-场景匹配与策略学习显式解耦来实现突破。该方法的核心是采用对应关系感知的扩散策略，直接基于稠密语义对应关系调节机器人动作。这种架构分离解决了对应关系识别与动作适应性之间的内在冲突，从而实现了鲁棒的分布外迁移。我们的框架将视觉基础模型与新颖的两阶段匹配算法相结合，能够动态建立可靠的对应关系。在RLBench基准测试及真实世界操作任务上的广泛评估证实，MatchingPolicy在跨未见物体实例和语义类别时均能实现可靠泛化，展现出卓越的小样本性能。

title: Throwing a Tight Spiral American Football by a Humanoid Robot
summary: Accurate throwing of the American football requires precise regulation of release conditions, where coupled linear and angular momentum determine flight stability and targeting accuracy. While prior work on robotic object throwing has largely focused on generating dynamically feasible release velocities using open-gripper paradigms, explicit control of spin injection at detachment remains underexplored, particularly for aerodynamically anisotropic objects like the American football. In this paper, we present the spin-stabilized controlled tight spiral throw of an American football by a humanoid robot. Achieving this requires (i) accurately reaching the desired coupled momentum, which often involves high degrees-of-freedom (DoF) movements completed within approximately half a second, and (ii) managing the complex transient contact dynamics that arise during the sub-100-millisecond release phase, when the football is effectively underactuated as it moves partially across the fingers. To this end, we develop a coupled whole-body control strategy where the lower body is performing informed stabilization while the upper body is further divided into two phases with (i) a throw phase accelerating the football to a target state through trajectory optimization and tracking, and (ii) a follow-through phase utilizing model predictive control to actively control the wrist and remaining in-contact fingers. The proposed framework is empirically validated on a 29-DoF Unitree G1 humanoid equipped with a 7-DoF Dex3-1 three-fingered gripper. The thrown American football reaches up to 93.6% spin efficiency and a 0.286 radians linear-velocity-to-nose-alignment (nose-angle) error (where an ``ideal'' tight spiral corresponds to 100 % spin efficiency and 0 radians nose-angle error) at up to a 5.35 m/s linear velocity and an angular velocity of 14.5 rad/s.
tldr: This paper presents a whole-body control framework for a humanoid robot to throw an American football with a tight spiral, achieving high spin efficiency and low nose-angle error through trajectory optimization for the throw phase and model-predictive control for the follow-through phase.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种人形机器人整体控制框架，实现了美式橄榄球的旋转稳定精准投掷，通过轨迹优化和模型预测控制分别控制投掷阶段和跟随阶段，达到了高旋转效率和低鼻角误差。
summary_zh: 美式橄榄球的精准投掷需要精确调节出手条件，其中线性动量与角动量的耦合决定了飞行稳定性与瞄准精度。既有机器人抛掷物体的研究多聚焦于通过开爪范式生成动态可行的出手速度，而对脱离瞬间自旋注入的显式控制仍探究不足，尤其针对美式橄榄球这类气动各向异性物体。本文提出由仿人机器人完成自旋稳定的受控紧螺旋抛掷美式橄榄球。实现该目标需要：(i) 精准达到期望的耦合动量，这通常涉及在半秒内完成高自由度运动；(ii) 管控不足百毫秒的出手阶段中产生的复杂瞬态接触动力学——此时橄榄球在手指间部分移动时呈现欠驱动状态。为此我们开发了耦合全身控制策略：下肢执行信息增强稳定，上肢进一步划分为两个阶段——(i) 投掷阶段通过轨迹优化与跟踪将橄榄球加速至目标状态，(ii) 跟随阶段采用模型预测控制主动控制手腕及持续接触的手指。该框架在配备7自由度Dex3-1三指夹爪的29自由度Unitree G1仿人机器人上得到实证验证。抛掷橄榄球的自旋效率最高达93.6%，线速度-鼻锥对准（鼻角）误差为0.286弧度（其中"理想"紧螺旋对应100%自旋效率与0弧度鼻角误差），最高线速度达5.35米/秒，角速度达14.5弧度/秒。

title: Zetta $ζ$: An Efficient Closed-Loop Embodied Harness for Self-Evolving Physical Intelligence
summary: Embodied agents are increasingly used to close the gap left by end-to-end policy models. Yet the agentic path has not realized closed-loop learning in physical execution: existing harnesses remain largely open-loop, following fixed skills during rollout and reflecting only after an episode completes. Such post-hoc reflection cannot govern execution as it unfolds, because physical interaction requires decisions to track rapidly changing robot-environment states at a frequency beyond today's large agentic models. We present Zetta, a closed-loop embodied harness that evolves code-based runtime critics and recovery skills online while keeping the base policy frozen. Through three timescale-separated loops, Zetta provides action-frequency governance, rollout-level critic-recovery proposal, and validation-gated skill updates. Together with Z-Infra, a rollout infrastructure decoupling agent logic from heterogeneous execution resources, Zetta achieves state-of-the-art success on LIBERO-Pro and RoboCasa under our current rollout budget, reaching 90.8% and 93.6%, with an 11.1x inference speedup; success continues to scale with self-exploration experience; learned skills transfer zero-shot, and clear robotic "Aha Moments" emerge. These results show that closed-loop harness self-evolution opens a scaling path for reliable physical intelligence.
tldr: Zetta is a closed-loop embodied harness that uses code-based runtime critics and a three-timescale-loop architecture to enable real-time, self-evolving skill updates for physical agents, achieving state-of-the-art success rates on manipulation benchmarks with significant inference speedup.
tldr_zh: Zetta 是一个闭环具身框架，通过基于代码的运行时批评者和三时间尺度循环架构，实现物理智能体的实时自进化技能更新，在操作基准测试中取得最高成功率并大幅提升推理速度。
summary_zh: 具身智能体正越来越多地被用于弥合端到端策略模型留下的差距。然而，具身路径尚未实现物理执行中的闭环学习：现有框架大多保持开环状态，在部署过程中遵循固定技能，并且仅在一个回合结束后进行反思。这种事后反思无法在执行过程中进行实时调控，因为物理交互要求以超越当前大型智能体模型能力的频率做出决策，以跟踪快速变化的机器人-环境状态。我们提出Zetta——一种闭环具身框架，它在保持基础策略冻结的同时，在线演化基于代码的运行时评判器与恢复技能。通过三个时间尺度分离的循环，Zetta提供了动作频率级的调控、部署级的评判器-恢复方案生成，以及经过验证门控的技能更新。结合Z-Infra（一种将智能体逻辑与异构执行资源解耦的部署基础设施），Zetta在当前部署预算下，在LIBERO-Pro和RoboCasa上达到了最先进的成功率，分别为90.8%和93.6%，推理速度提升了11.1倍；其成功率随自我探索经验持续扩展；习得技能可实现零样本迁移，并出现了清晰的机器人“顿悟时刻”。这些结果表明，闭环框架的自我演化为可靠的物理智能开辟了一条规模化路径。

title: ViHaTeleop: A Low-Cost, Lightweight Visual-Haptic Teleoperation System for Dexterous Manipulation Learning
summary: Learning from demonstration is a promising approach for dexterous manipulation, but collecting high-quality contact-critical demonstrations remains difficult with low-cost teleoperation hardware. We present ViHaTeleop, a lightweight (0.7 kg), low-cost (\$550) visual-haptic teleoperation system with SLAM-based wrist tracking, camera-based hand tracking, and finger-wise vibrotactile feedback through Linear Resonant Actuators (LRA). The system includes several design choices (LED illumination, fisheye hand camera, and tactile-aware retargeting constraints) and is deployed on Franka + LEAP Hand + 9DTact in both real and simulated environments. Under matched with/without-haptic conditions with nine participants across six contact-critical tasks, haptics improved success rates across all tasks (+2.2 to +15.6 percentage points), while completion-time effects were task-dependent. Subjective ratings showed significant gains in contact clarity and grasp confidence in both simulation and real-world settings (Wilcoxon signed-rank, $p<0.05$). We also integrate a lightweight depth-camera-based tactile proxy in Isaac Sim, enabling a full pipeline from multi-modal demonstration collection to visual-tactile policy training. Preliminary downstream validation by training visual-tactile policies from collected demonstrations shows tactile cues benefit contact-critical subtasks (peg-in-hole: +17 percentage points over vision-only).
tldr: ViHaTeleop is a low-cost, lightweight visual-haptic teleoperation system that improves contact-critical dexterous manipulation demonstration collection via SLAM-based wrist tracking, camera-based hand tracking, and finger-wise vibrotactile feedback. User studies and downstream policy training (e.g., peg-in-hole) confirm that haptic feedback boosts task success and grasp confidence.
tldr_zh: ViHaTeleop是一种低成本、轻量级的视觉-触觉遥操作系统，通过SLAM腕部追踪、摄像头手部追踪和手指级振动触觉反馈，改善了接触关键型灵巧操作示范采集。用户研究和下游策略训练（如插销入孔）证实触觉反馈提升了任务成功率和抓取信心。
summary_zh: 从演示中学习是灵巧操作领域一种前景广阔的方法，但使用低成本遥操作硬件收集高质量、关键接触的演示数据仍然困难。我们提出了ViHaTeleop，一种轻量级（0.7公斤）、低成本（550美元）的视觉-触觉遥操作系统，该系统具有基于SLAM的手腕追踪、基于摄像头的手部追踪，以及通过线性谐振致动器（LRA）实现的指尖级振动触觉反馈。系统包含若干设计选择（LED照明、鱼眼手部摄像头和触觉感知的重定向约束），并部署在Franka + LEAP Hand + 9DTact平台上，同时应用于真实与仿真环境。在六项关键接触任务中，针对九名参与者进行的有/无触觉条件匹配实验表明，触觉反馈在所有任务中均提升了成功概率（+2.2至+15.6个百分点），而完成时间的影响则因任务而异。主观评分显示，在仿真和真实环境中，接触清晰度和抓握信心均有显著提升（Wilcoxon符号秩检验，$p<0.05$）。我们还在Isaac Sim中集成了一个基于轻量级深度摄像头的触觉代理，从而实现了从多模态演示采集到视觉-触觉策略训练的完整流程。基于所采集演示训练视觉-触觉策略的初步下游验证表明，触觉提示有益于关键接触子任务（插销入孔：相较于纯视觉方法提升17个百分点）。

title: NebulaVLA: A Dual-Frequency Vision-Language-Action Model With Guide Action for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Real-world deployment of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models is often bottlenecked by efficiency-performance trade-offs, cross-embodiment generalization, and execution smoothness. We present NebulaVLA, an asynchronous dual-frequency architecture that decouples high-level semantic reasoning from low-level action control, optimizing computational resources and modularity. To bridge semantic gaps across heterogeneous robots, we introduce GESTURE-7, a unified language-grounded action representation. Furthermore, our Guide Action algorithm enforces kinematic continuity via mask-based smoothness constraints. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that NebulaVLA significantly outperforms synchronous baselines, achieving an 85.5\% average success rate on LIBERO-Plus and accelerating action generation by \textasciitilde 2.7$\times$. This asynchronous design enables highly efficient and responsive control for practical robotics.
tldr: NebulaVLA introduces an asynchronous dual-frequency architecture with a guide action algorithm and a unified language-grounded action representation, significantly improving efficiency and performance for robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: NebulaVLA 提出了一种异步双频架构，结合引导动作算法和统一语言接地动作表示，显著提升了机器人操作的效率和性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在实际部署中常受限于效率与性能的权衡、跨本体泛化能力以及执行流畅性。本文提出NebulaVLA——一种异步双频架构，将高层语义推理与底层动作控制解耦，从而优化计算资源利用与模块化设计。为弥合异构机器人间的语义鸿沟，我们引入GESTURE-7统一语言化动作表征。此外，所提引导动作算法通过基于掩码的平滑性约束强制执行运动学连续性。综合评估表明，NebulaVLA显著优于同步基线系统，在LIBERO-Plus数据集上实现85.5%的平均成功率，并将动作生成速度提升约2.7倍。该异步设计为实际机器人应用提供了高效且响应灵敏的控制方案。

title: Robot-Body-Aware Traversal Risk Graph Planning for Wheeled-Legged Robots in Complex Terrain
summary: Traversal Risk Graphs (TRGs) provide a compact, terrain-aware representation for global navigation, but native TRG costs are computed over circular node neighborhoods and edge-aligned terrain regions rather than the robot's oriented body footprint. For wheeled-legged robots, this abstraction can miss partial support loss and body-terrain interference, especially during turns. We present Robot-Body-Aware TRG planning (RB-TRG), which builds on the sparse TRG representation and lifts edge-wise terrain-risk search to heading- and turn-aware body-risk transitions. An oriented rectangular footprint is sampled along graph edges and yaw sweeps to measure longitudinal support variation, lateral inclination, terrain interference, and exposure to untrusted map regions. Mean-and-upper-tail features are incorporated into transition costs, whose accumulated value is minimized by A* over ordered node-pair states, preserving TRG construction and its planning interface. We evaluate RB-TRG in a same-graph study on four scanned terrain environments and in paired closed-loop MuJoCo trials. RB-TRG reduces the three core geometric body-placement metrics and increases end-to-end success from 51.5% to 68.5%, while increasing mean path length by 2.3%. A Go2-W deployment further demonstrates RB-TRG with a full LiDAR navigation stack, which received the Best Autonomy and Best Mobility awards at the IEEE ICRA 2026 Legged Robot Challenges. The code for RB-TRG is released at https://github.com/ZhiqiaoGuo/RB-TRG.
tldr: RB-TRG enhances Traversal Risk Graphs with robot-body-aware cost computation for wheeled-legged robots, improving navigation success in complex terrain by modeling oriented footprint support and body-terrain interference during turns.
tldr_zh: RB-TRG通过面向机器人主体的成本计算改进遍历风险图，在复杂地形中提升轮腿机器人的导航成功率，建模转向时的支撑损失和地形干扰。
summary_zh: 遍历风险图（TRG）为全局导航提供了紧凑且地形感知的表示，但其原生成本计算基于圆形节点邻域及边对齐地形区域，而非机器人有朝向的车体足迹。对于轮腿机器人而言，这种抽象可能导致部分支撑缺失和车体-地形干涉，尤其在转弯过程中。我们提出面向机器人车体的TRG规划方法（RB-TRG），该方法基于稀疏TRG表示，将边级地形风险搜索提升为考虑航向与转弯的车体风险转移模型。沿图边与偏航扫描方向对有朝向的矩形足迹进行采样，以测量纵向支撑变化、侧向倾斜、地形干涉以及对不可信地图区域的暴露程度。将均值与上尾特征纳入转移成本，其累积值通过A*算法在有序节点对状态下最小化，同时保留TRG的构建流程及其规划接口。我们在四个扫描地形环境中进行相同图研究，并通过配对闭环MuJoCo试验评估RB-TRG。RB-TRG降低了三项核心几何车体位姿指标，将端到端成功率从51.5%提升至68.5%，同时平均路径长度增加2.3%。基于Go2-W平台的部署进一步展示了融合全栈LiDAR导航的RB-TRG系统，该系统在IEEE ICRA 2026腿式机器人挑战赛中荣获最佳自主性与最佳机动性两项大奖。RB-TRG代码已发布于https://github.com/ZhiqiaoGuo/RB-TRG。

title: Arm-Aware Guided Dexterous Grasp Generation with Arm-Agnostic Grasp Models
summary: Dexterous grasp generation that considers arm-related constraints is crucial in real-world scenarios involving arm environment collision avoidance, workspace boundary grasps, and consecutive grasping. Existing hand-centric grasp models, which primarily focus on the floating hand's pose, are insufficient for such cases. Conventional arm-aware methods either rely on rejection sampling to discard infeasible samples or require retraining on arm-specific data, leading to low sample efficiency under adverse conditions or limited generalization across different robots and environments. To overcome these limitations, this letter presents an arm-aware dexterous grasp generation framework that leverages pretrained arm-agnostic grasp models while integrating arm and environmental information only at inference time. Specifically, we formulate arm-aware constrained grasp generation as a joint optimization of hand pose and arm configuration, and derive closed-form gradients for arm-related constraints. Assuming the hand pose distribution is represented by a diffusion model, we prove that gradient-based optimization is equivalent to guided diffusion sampling, steering near-feasible samples toward the feasible region. Through comprehensive evaluation involving 10k objects across 6 scenarios, we demonstrate that the proposed framework generates feasible grasps in highly constrained settings with significantly higher probability, highlighting its advantages in real-world applications. Supplementary materials and appendix are available at https://arm-aware-dexgrasp.github.io/.
tldr: This paper proposes a dexterous grasp generation framework that uses a pretrained arm-agnostic diffusion model and incorporates arm-related constraints via guided diffusion sampling at inference, eliminating retraining or rejection sampling.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种灵巧抓取生成框架，利用预训练的与手臂无关的扩散模型，并通过推理时的引导扩散采样融入手臂相关约束，避免重新训练或拒绝采样。
summary_zh: 在涉及机械臂环境碰撞规避、工作空间边界抓取以及连续抓取的真实场景中，生成考虑机械臂相关约束的灵巧抓取至关重要。现有以手部为中心的抓取模型主要关注浮动手部位的姿态，难以应对此类情况。传统的机械臂感知方法要么依赖拒绝采样来舍弃不可行样本，要么需要在特定机械臂数据上重新训练，导致在不利条件下采样效率低下，或在不同机器人及环境中的泛化能力受限。为克服这些局限，本文提出一种机械臂感知的灵巧抓取生成框架，该框架利用预训练的与机械臂无关的抓取模型，仅在推理时整合机械臂与环境信息。具体而言，我们将机械臂感知的约束抓取生成问题形式化为手部姿态与机械臂构型的联合优化，并推导出机械臂相关约束的闭式梯度。基于手部位姿分布由扩散模型表示的假设，我们证明基于梯度的优化等价于引导式扩散采样，可将接近可行的样本引导至可行区域。通过涉及6种场景下1万个物体的综合评估，我们证明所提框架在高度约束环境中能以显著更高的概率生成可行抓取，突显其在真实场景中的优势。补充材料与附录可通过https://arm-aware-dexgrasp.github.io/获取。

title: Cyclops: LiDAR as a Camera That Dreams in Color
summary: Conventionally, robotic perception relies heavily on cameras due to the rich semantic texture they provide. However, their performance degrades significantly in low-light or high-dynamic-range environments. Conversely, while Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) captures illumination-invariant geometric and intensity properties, the resulting data are typically single-channel and sparse, creating a significant modality gap when applying vision models pre-trained on RGB datasets. In this paper, we propose Cyclops, a framework that translates sparse Non-Repetitive Scanning LiDAR (NRS-LiDAR) intensity into RGB video, enabling camera-free inference for all-day perception tasks. Our approach first converts sparse LiDAR intensity projections into dense representations via a frozen pre-trained densification module, serving as a geometrically rich source condition. The dense intensity latent is then transported toward the target RGB distribution through Latent Bridge Matching (LBM) with a learned velocity field in a few ODE integration steps. To mitigate inter-frame flickering, we inject prior-frame context via temporal attention layers and further formulate the velocity field as a policy optimized by a differentiable terminal reward that encourages terminal fidelity through backpropagation along the ODE trajectory. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the synthesized RGB, including those generated under near-dark conditions, enable standard RGB-based perception models to substantially outperform both LiDAR baselines and conventional cameras on semantic segmentation, lane detection, and point cloud colorization across diverse lighting conditions.
tldr: Cyclops translates sparse LiDAR intensity into dense RGB video via a latent bridge matching approach, enabling camera-free all-day robotic perception that outperforms both LiDAR baselines and conventional cameras under challenging lighting conditions.
tldr_zh: Cyclops 通过潜在桥接匹配将稀疏的 LiDAR 强度转换为稠密的 RGB 视频，实现了在恶劣光照条件下无需摄像头的全天候机器人感知，性能优于 LiDAR 基线和传统摄像头。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
传统上，由于相机能提供丰富的语义纹理，机器人感知严重依赖相机。然而，在低光照或高动态范围环境中，其性能会显著下降。相比之下，尽管激光雷达（LiDAR）能捕获光照不变的几何与强度特性，但其生成的数据通常为单通道且稀疏，这导致在应用基于RGB数据集预训练的视觉模型时存在显著的模态差异。本文提出Cyclops框架，该框架将稀疏的非重复扫描激光雷达（NRS-LiDAR）强度数据转换为RGB视频，从而支持全天候感知任务的无相机推理。我们的方法首先通过冻结的预训练致密化模块将稀疏的LiDAR强度投影转换为密集表示，作为几何信息丰富的源条件。随后，通过潜在桥接匹配（LBM）方法，利用学习到的速度场，在少量常微分方程（ODE）积分步骤中将密集强度潜变量迁移至目标RGB分布。为减轻帧间闪烁，我们通过时序注意力层注入先前帧的上下文，并进一步将速度场表述为策略，该策略通过可微分终端奖励进行优化，该奖励沿ODE轨迹反向传播以强化终端保真度。大量实验表明，所合成的RGB图像（包括近黑暗条件下生成的图像）能够使基于标准RGB的感知模型在语义分割、车道检测及点云着色任务中，在多种光照条件下显著超越LiDAR基线模型和传统相机的性能。

title: HiPHI: A Large-Scale Benchmark for High-Precision Human Motion and Object-Interaction
summary: Humanoid intelligence requires learning over an extremely diverse space of whole-body motions and physically grounded interactions. However, existing embodied datasets remain fundamentally limited: internet-scale video data lack precise physical states and interaction grounding, while laboratory motion datasets provide high fidelity but only narrow behavioral coverage. This mismatch creates a critical bottleneck for scalable humanoid policy learning. We present HiPHI, a 600+ hour scale high-fidelity whole-body human motion dataset designed to systematically maximize coverage of the human motion and interaction manifold. HiPHI is theoretically guided by FrameNet, a linguistic framework organizing human primitives. Created using an optical motion capture pipeline, HiPHI provides sub-millimeter spatial marker tracking accuracy for full-body human motion and mesh-level object trajectories. We further introduce a benchmark suite evaluating motion-space diversity, interaction grounding, object consistency, and physical AI applications. Our analyses demonstrate that HiPHI significantly expands motion coverage compared to existing motion datasets while maintaining high-fidelity interaction quality, and establishes a scalable data foundation for training, evaluating, and generalizing humanoid policies in real-world embodied tasks, where similar extensions are also applicable to motion prior models in computer graphics.
tldr: HiPHI is a 600+ hour high-precision human motion and object-interaction dataset using optical motion capture with sub-millimeter accuracy, designed to support humanoid policy learning, embodied AI, and motion prior models.
tldr_zh: HiPHI是一个600小时以上、利用光学动捕提供亚毫米精度的高保真人-物交互数据集，旨在为人形机器人策略学习、具身AI和运动先验模型提供数据基础。
summary_zh: 类人智能需要学习极其多样化的全身运动及物理交互数据空间。然而，现有具身数据集存在根本性局限：互联网规模的视频数据缺乏精确的物理状态与交互锚定，而实验室运动数据集虽具备高保真度，但行为覆盖范围狭窄。这种不匹配为类人策略学习的可扩展性造成了关键瓶颈。我们提出HiPHI——一个600+小时规模的高保真全身人体运动数据集，旨在系统性地最大化覆盖人体运动与交互流形。HiPHI的理论指导源于FrameNet这一组织人类原始动作的语言学框架。通过采用光学动作捕捉流水线构建，HiPHI为全身人体运动提供亚毫米级空间标记追踪精度，并包含网格级物体轨迹。我们进一步引入基准测试套件，用于评估运动空间多样性、交互锚定性、物体一致性及物理AI应用。分析表明，相较于现有运动数据集，HiPHI显著拓展了运动覆盖范围，同时保持高保真交互质量，并为真实世界具身任务中类人策略的训练、评估与泛化建立了可扩展的数据基础，其类似扩展方法亦可应用于计算机图形学中的运动先验模型。

title: Trajectory-Level Automatic Curriculum Learning for Legged Locomotion on Unstructured Terrain
summary: Training locomotion policies for complex unstructured terrain requires a curriculum to avoid early exploration failures. However, since unstructured terrain lacks explicit difficulty ordering for curriculum design, existing methods resort to heuristic curricula over parameterized terrains. This abstraction limits generalization, as policies can overadapt to near-fixed perceptual patterns. To address this, we propose \textbf{\ourname{}}, an \textbf{T}rajectory-level \textbf{A}utomatic \textbf{C}urriculum \textbf{L}earning framework that generates training tasks directly from unstructured terrain maps. At each curriculum update, the evaluator learns a difficulty function for the current policy that maps a given trajectory task to a difficulty score. The sampler then proposes new trajectories guided by the learned evaluator as the curriculum for the next policy update. This forms a closed loop in which the curriculum is iteratively matched to the evolving policy. Quantitative and qualitative experiments show that \ourname{} continuously provides effective curricula on unstructured terrain, improving trajectory success rate by \(56.3\%\) over direct training without curriculum. Compared with handcrafted curriculum learning, our method improves success rate by \(18.5\%\) on the hardest terrain tasks and by up to \(39.74\%\) when evaluating traversal from diverse approach directions on the same obstacle type.
tldr: This paper introduces a trajectory-level automatic curriculum learning framework for legged locomotion on unstructured terrain, where an evaluator learns difficulty scores for trajectory tasks and a sampler proposes new trajectories to form a closed-loop curriculum that adapts to the evolving policy, achieving significant improvements in success rate.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于非结构化地形上腿部运动的轨迹级自动课程学习框架，通过评估器学习轨迹任务的难度分数，采样器根据评估结果提出新轨迹，形成闭环课程以适应不断进化的策略，从而显著提升了成功率。
summary_zh: 针对复杂非结构化地形的运动策略训练需要一种课程机制，以避免早期探索失败。然而，由于非结构化地形缺乏明确的难度排序来设计课程，现有方法转而采用基于参数化地形的启发式课程。这种抽象限制了泛化能力，因为策略可能过度适应近乎固定的感知模式。为解决这一问题，我们提出\textbf{\ourname{}}——一种轨迹级自动课程学习框架，可直接从非结构化地形地图生成训练任务。在每次课程更新时，评估器学习当前策略的难度函数，将给定轨迹任务映射为难度分值。随后，采样器基于学习到的评估器引导，提出新轨迹作为下一次策略更新的课程。这形成了闭环，使课程能够迭代适配不断演化的策略。定量与定性实验表明，\ourname{}能在非结构化地形上持续提供有效课程，相比无课程直接训练，轨迹成功率提升56.3%。与手工设计的课程学习相比，我们的方法在最困难地形任务上提升18.5%的成功率，并在从不同接近方向评估同一障碍物类型时，成功率最高提升39.74%。

title: SurgVIL: Scaling Surgical Robot Imitation Learning with Open-source Surgical Videos
summary: Learning-based surgical robot autonomy requires large-scale demonstrations with synchronized videos and robot actions, but such data are exceedingly rare in clinical or realistic tissue settings because robot kinematics are typically inaccessible outside controlled research systems. In contrast, phantom data collected on research platforms provide accurate action labels but lack the visual diversity of real tissue. We propose SurgVIL, a framework for scaling surgical robot imitation learning using open-source surgical videos. SurgVIL combines kinematically labeled phantom robot demonstrations with surgical videos from open-source datasets and online sources for policy learning. Since these videos lack robot motion labels, we estimate approximate kinematics as weak supervision. We evaluate SurgVIL on two da Vinci robot tasks: needle pick-up and cholecystectomy cutting. Across ACT, $π_0$, and GR00T-H backbones, adding surgical videos substantially improves generalization to real-tissue and out-of-distribution settings, suggesting a scalable path from phantom training toward generalizable surgical robot policies.
tldr: SurgVIL scales surgical robot imitation learning by combining limited phantom robot demonstrations with weak-supervision labels from abundant open-source surgical videos, significantly improving generalization to real-tissue settings across multiple policy backbones.
tldr_zh: SurgVIL 通过将有限的仿体机器人演示与来自开源手术视频的弱监督标签相结合，扩展了手术机器人模仿学习，在多种策略骨干上显著提升了向真实组织场景的泛化能力。
summary_zh: 基于学习的手术机器人自主性需要大量带有同步视频和机器人动作的大规模演示，然而这类数据在临床或真实组织环境中极为罕见，因为机器人运动学通常仅可在受控研究系统外获取。相比之下，在研究平台上收集的体模数据虽能提供精确的动作标签，但缺乏真实组织的视觉多样性。我们提出SurgVIL框架，旨在利用开源手术视频来扩展手术机器人模仿学习。SurgVIL将带有运动学标签的体模机器人演示与来自开源数据集及在线资源的手术视频相结合，用于策略学习。由于这些视频缺乏机器人运动标签，我们估计近似的运动学作为弱监督信号。我们在两项达芬奇机器人任务上评估SurgVIL：拾针和胆囊切除切割。在ACT、$π_0$和GR00T-H骨干网络下，添加手术视频显著提升了对真实组织及分布外场景的泛化能力，表明了一条从体模训练通向通用化手术机器人策略的可扩展路径。

title: ScenarioCharacterization: A Modular Toolkit for Characterizing Safety across Trajectory Datasets
summary:
We introduce ScenarioCharacterization, an open-source framework for automated, dataset-agnostic profiling of driving scenarios in trajectory datasets. Our framework is packaged as a modular, configuration-driven pipeline of three layers: a dataset adapter that maps custom datasets onto an open Scenario representation, a characterizer that performs feature extraction, behavior probing, and criticality scoring at scenario and agent levels, and an analysis layer for scenario visualization and feature, score, and probe analyses. Because the layers communicate only through Pydantic-validated schemas composed via configurations, a new dataset can easily plug in without rewriting the characterization and analysis stack.
  This technical report describes the design and APIs, shows example outputs on Waymo Open Motion, Argoverse2, and nuPlan, and discusses downstream uses of the approach. The framework is available at https://github.com/navarrs/ScenarioCharacterization.
tldr: ScenarioCharacterization is an open-source, modular toolkit for dataset-agnostic profiling of driving scenarios, featuring plug-and-play adapters, feature extraction, behavior probing, and criticality scoring, demonstrated on Waymo, Argoverse, and nuPlan.
tldr_zh: ScenarioCharacterization 是一个开源、模块化的驾驶场景分析工具包，支持数据集无关的场景特征提取、行为探测和关键性评分，已在 Waymo、Argoverse 和 nuPlan 上验证。
summary_zh:
我们提出ScenarioCharacterization——一个用于轨迹数据集中驾驶场景自动、数据集无关特征描述的开源框架。该框架采用模块化、配置驱动的三层流水线结构：数据集适配器层将自定义数据集映射到开放的场景表示；特征描述层在场景和智能体层级执行特征提取、行为探测与关键性评分；分析层则负责场景可视化、特征分析、评分分析及探测分析。由于各层仅通过由配置生成的Pydantic验证模式进行通信，新数据集可轻松接入而无需重写特征描述与分析堆栈。

本技术报告阐述了框架设计与API接口，展示了在Waymo Open Motion、Argoverse2和nuPlan上的示例输出，并讨论了该方法的后续应用。框架代码已开源至https://github.com/navarrs/ScenarioCharacterization。

title: Revisiting Open-Loop Execution in Robotics: Toward Reactive, Higher-Performing Policies
summary: Action chunking --- the practice of predicting a sequence of actions and executing a prefix open-loop --- has emerged as a key enabler of recent progress in imitation learning for robotic manipulation. However, executing long open-loop prefixes reduces reactivity, limiting policies' ability to correct for errors. Further, the mechanisms underlying these performance benefits remain poorly understood: prior works cite mitigating compounding errors, absorbing inference latency, or smoothing motions, but provide limited controlled evidence or guidance for preserving reactivity. In this work, we argue that long open-loop execution primarily helps short-context policies imitate "non-Markovian demonstrations". Across four simulation and two real-world tasks, we show that expert non-Markovianity strongly shapes the relationship between task success and open-loop execution horizon. Further, we investigate the impact of compounding errors --- the prevailing explanation for long open-loop execution in prior work --- and find that while they matter, expert non-Markovianity has a much stronger impact in our experimental setting. Finally, we show that when policies are provided with a sufficiently long context, open-loop execution is no longer beneficial and the most reactive, closed-loop policies perform best. While imitation learning has seen great success using long open-loop execution, our findings motivate long-context, reactive policies as a more principled and performant paradigm.
tldr: This paper investigates the role of open-loop execution in robotic imitation learning, finding that expert non-Markovianity, not compounding errors, primarily drives its benefits, and that long-context reactive policies can outperform open-loop ones.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了机器人模仿学习中开环执行的作用，发现专家非马尔可夫性而非累积误差是其优势的主要原因，并表明长上下文反应式策略可以胜过开环策略。
summary_zh: 动作分块（Action Chunking）——即预测一组动作序列并执行开环前缀——已成为近期机器人操作模仿学习进展的关键推动因素。然而，执行较长的开环前缀会降低反应能力，限制策略纠正错误的能力。此外，这些性能优势背后的机制仍不明确：以往研究将其归因于缓解复合误差、吸收推理延迟或平滑运动，但缺乏控制性实验证据或保持反应能力的指导。在本工作中，我们认为，长开环执行的主要作用是帮助短上下文策略模仿“非马尔可夫演示”。通过四项仿真任务和两项真实世界任务，我们展示了专家策略的非马尔可夫性显著影响任务成功率与开环执行步长之间的关系。此外，我们研究了复合误差的影响——这是以往工作中对长开环执行的主流解释——并发现，虽然复合误差确实存在影响，但在我们的实验设置中，专家非马尔可夫性的作用更强。最后，我们证明，当向策略提供足够长的上下文时，开环执行不再具有优势，而最具反应能力的闭环策略表现最佳。尽管模仿学习通过长开环执行取得了巨大成功，但我们的研究结果促使长上下文、高反应性策略成为更具原则性和高性能的范式。

title: RAPAC-DP: Response-Aligned Pending-Action Compensation for Diffusion Policies under Delayed Execution
summary: Cloud-side inference gives imitation-learning policies access to greater computational resources, but communication and computation delays can degrade control performance. To compensate for these delays, we propose RAPAC-DP, a response-aligned pending-action compensation framework designed for both diffusion- and flow-based action generators. RAPAC-DP encodes the actions already scheduled for execution before the cloud response arrives into a pending-action sequence that serves as the conditioning input to a parameter-efficient compensation pathway. When delay effects are negligible, bypassing this pathway exactly recovers the frozen base policy. For training, RAPAC-DP constructs delay-conditioned samples from delay-free demonstrations, requiring neither explicit system dynamics nor additional delayed demonstrations. At the largest fixed delay tested on Kinetix, RAPAC-DP retained 81.4% of its overall delay-free performance. At the largest fixed delay tested on each RoboMimic task, it achieved a mean success rate of 0.633 across the three tasks. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of pending-action compensation for cloud-deployed imitation-learning policies.
tldr: Proposes a delay-compensation framework for diffusion/flow-based imitation policies in cloud-robotic control, using pending-action sequences as conditioning inputs to recover performance under communication delays.
tldr_zh: 提出一种针对云端机器人控制中通信延迟的补偿框架，通过将待执行动作序列作为条件输入来恢复扩散/流策略的性能。
summary_zh: 云侧推理使模仿学习策略能够访问更强大的计算资源，但通信与计算延迟会降低控制性能。为补偿这些延迟，我们提出RAPAC-DP——一种面向响应对齐的待执行动作补偿框架，适用于基于扩散模型和基于流模型的动作生成器。RAPAC-DP将云响应到达前已调度执行的动作编码为待执行动作序列，该序列作为参数高效补偿路径的条件输入。当延迟效应可忽略时，跳过该路径可精确恢复冻结的基础策略。训练时，RAPAC-DP从无延迟演示中构建延迟条件样本，无需显式系统动力学模型或额外延迟演示。在Kinetix平台最大固定延迟测试中，RAPAC-DP保留了其整体无延迟性能的81.4%；在RoboMimic各任务的最大固定延迟测试中，其在三个任务上实现了0.633的平均成功率。这些结果证明了待执行动作补偿对云部署模仿学习策略的有效性。

title: Pre-training Visual Dexterity in Simulation
summary: Large-scale pre-training has made robot policy fine-tuning increasingly data-efficient, but this progress has largely been driven by datasets and embodiments built around simple parallel-jaw grippers. Dexterous, multi-fingered hands remain comparatively data-starved because real teleoperation is costly to scale, while human hand video is off-embodiment and requires lossy pose estimation and retargeting. We introduce Simulation Pre-training for Dexterity (SPD), a pre-training framework for dexterous manipulation that uses data entirely collected in simulation. In SPD, humans manipulate virtual objects inside a VR headset, enabling on-embodiment trajectories and robot-free collection. With the help of five operators, we collect 75 hours of multi-task dexterous manipulation over one week, and use it to pre-train a causal transformer on a sequence modeling objective. We study the benefits of simulation pre-training on real-world tasks by fine-tuning on 1-2 hours of physical demonstrations on a 56-DoF bimanual dexterous setup. We find that our approach outperforms training behavior cloning policies from scratch, showing that simulation teleoperation is a viable pre-training source for real-world dexterous manipulation. We perform ablation studies, measuring the benefits of history conditioning and short action chunks for reactive control.
tldr: This paper introduces SPD, a framework that uses VR-based simulation teleoperation to collect multi-task dexterous manipulation data for pre-training a transformer policy, which after fine-tuning on few real-world demonstrations outperforms training from scratch on bimanual dexterous tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出 SPD 框架，通过 VR 模拟遥操作收集多任务灵巧操作数据来预训练 Transformer 策略，在少量真实演示微调后，其双手机器人灵巧操作性能优于从零训练。
summary_zh: 大规模预训练使得机器人策略微调的数据效率日益提高，但这一进展主要得益于围绕简单平行颚式夹爪构建的数据集和具身形态。相比之下，灵巧的多指手仍面临数据匮乏的困境，原因在于真实遥操作成本高昂难以规模化，而人类手部视频存在具身形态不匹配的问题，且需要经历有损的姿态估计与重定向过程。我们提出灵巧性仿真预训练（SPD）框架，该框架完全利用仿真数据对灵巧操作进行预训练。在SPD中，操作者通过VR头显操控虚拟物体，从而获得具身对齐的轨迹数据，并实现无需实体机器人的数据采集。在五名操作员的协助下，我们在一周内收集了75小时的多任务灵巧操作数据，并基于序列建模目标对因果Transformer进行预训练。通过在具有56自由度的双臂灵巧操作平台上使用1-2小时的物理演示数据进行微调，我们研究了仿真预训练对真实世界任务的优势。实验表明，该方法优于从头训练的行为克隆策略，证明仿真遥操作可作为真实世界灵巧操作的有效预训练数据源。我们还进行了消融实验，量化了历史状态条件化与短动作块对反应式控制的增益。

title: Tactile Sim2Real without Tactile Simulation via Bottlenecked Latent Reconstruction
summary: Robot sensor designs, particularly tactile sensors, are highly diverse and evolve rapidly. Modeling each sensor in simulation demands substantial domain expertise and computational approximations can degrade the fidelity of the simulated signals. We propose Sim2Real via Bottlenecked Latent Reconstruction (SBLR), a framework that avoids sensor-specific simulation entirely by (1) training policies on a simulator-native oracle sensor that is easy to construct without modeling any particular sensor (e.g. we use a point-cloud and finger-tip forces as a tactile oracle), and (2) aligning real sensor latent embeddings to those of the oracle sensor at inference time. Policy training proceeds in two-stage: the policy first learns from the oracle sensor latents, then a bottlenecked latent reconstruction adapts it to the information loss expected when using the real sensor instead of the oracle. The alignment between oracle and real sensor is learned from unpaired random-play data collected in both simulation and the real world, using rectified-flow-based transformation networks trained on nearest-neighbor pseudo-pairs. Simulation experiments on three contact-rich tasks show that SBLR matches or approaches the performance of an oracle with direct access to tactile simulation. Hardware experiments on Peg Insertion and Gear Meshing with GelSight Mini and DIGIT sensors demonstrate 85-97.5% zero-shot success without requiring any sensor-specific modeling or calibration, outperforming a physics-based tactile simulation baseline by 7.5-15%.
tldr: This paper proposes a sim-to-real framework for tactile sensing that avoids sensor-specific simulation by training policies on an oracle sensor (point cloud + forces) and aligning real sensor latents to oracle latents via rectified-flow-based transformation, achieving 85-97.5% zero-shot success on hardware tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种触觉传感器的Sim2Real框架，避免针对特定传感器的仿真训练，通过将真实传感器隐编码与模拟环境中的理想传感器隐编码对齐，在硬件任务上实现了85-97.5%的零样本成功率。
summary_zh: 机器人传感器设计，尤其是触觉传感器，具有高度多样性且发展迅速。在仿真中对每种传感器建模需要大量领域专业知识，而计算近似会导致模拟信号保真度下降。我们提出基于瓶颈潜在重建的虚实映射框架（SBLR），该框架通过以下方式完全避免针对特定传感器的仿真：（1）在仿真器原生“神谕”传感器上训练策略，这种传感器无需建模任何具体传感器即可构建（例如，我们使用点云和指尖力作为触觉“神谕”）；（2）在推理阶段将真实传感器的潜在嵌入对齐至“神谕”传感器的潜在嵌入。策略训练分两阶段进行：策略首先从“神谕”传感器潜在编码中学习，随后通过瓶颈潜在重建使其适应实际使用真实传感器替代“神谕”时预期的信息损失。“神谕”与真实传感器的对齐通过无配对随机回放数据（分别在仿真和真实环境中采集）实现，并采用基于最近邻伪数据对的整流流变换网络进行训练。在三个接触密集型任务上的仿真实验表明，SBLR的性能可匹配或接近直接获取触觉仿真的“神谕”系统。基于GelSight Mini与DIGIT传感器的插销插入和齿轮啮合硬件实验显示，该方法在无需任何特定传感器建模或校准的情况下，零样本成功率达85%至97.5%，相比基于物理的触觉仿真基线提升7.5%至15%。

title: The Ethical Decision Head: Operationalizing Normative Ethics in Autonomous Vehicles via Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
summary: As autonomous vehicles (AVs) approach Level 4 and Level 5 operational capability [SAE International, 2018], their on- board decision systems must handle not only safety-critical locomotion but also their subsequent moral weight. This paper details the Ethical Decision Head (EDH), a deep re- inforcement learning (RL) framework that encodes ethical reasoning as a differentiable reward signal, enabling a pol- icy gradient agent to learn morally-aligned driving behavior in scenarios whose state representation is aligned with the CARLA simulation environment [Dosovitskiy et al., 2017]. Two normative frameworks are instantiated and evaluated: a Utilitarian framework minimizing total casualties and a Kan- tian framework enforcing course maintenance as a categori- cal imperative. The EDH is trained via Proximal Policy Op- timization (PPO) [Schulman et al., 2017] against a Bradley- Terry reward model [Bradley and Terry, 1952] learned from pairwise human preference annotations over 200 collision- imminent scenarios. Results reveal an asymmetry in the learnability of normative ethical frameworks under human su- pervision. The Kantian condition, which reduces to a con- stant prediction task under the codebook, serves as a pipeline control: it confirms training stability and rules out infrastruc- ture failure as an explanation for the utilitarian result. The Utilitarian agent learned something more unsettling: human raters rewarded self-sacrifice over casualty minimization, and the model learned that preference faithfully. This divergence between what humans prescribe in theory and what they re- ward in practice suggests that RLHF does not learn ethics as philosophers define it, but as humans live it.
tldr: This paper introduces the Ethical Decision Head (EDH), a deep RL framework that integrates normative ethics (Utilitarian and Kantian) into autonomous driving via RLHF, revealing a divergence between human prescriptive ethics and rewarded preferences.
tldr_zh: 本文提出伦理决策头（EDH），这是一个通过RLHF将规范伦理（功利主义与康德主义）编码到自动驾驶中的深度强化学习框架，揭示了人类在理论上规定的伦理与在实践中奖励的伦理之间的分歧。
summary_zh: 随着自动驾驶汽车（AVs）接近L4级和L5级运行能力[SAE International, 2018]，其车载决策系统不仅需要处理安全关键的操控问题，还必须应对随之而来的道德考量。本文详述了伦理决策头（Ethical Decision Head, EDH），这是一个深度强化学习（RL）框架，它将伦理推理编码为可微分的奖励信号，使得策略梯度智能体能够在状态表示与CARLA仿真环境[Dosovitskiy et al., 2017]一致的场景中学习符合道德规范的驾驶行为。文中实例化并评估了两种规范性框架：一种是最小化总伤亡人数的功利主义框架，另一种是将保持航向作为绝对命令的康德主义框架。EDH通过近端策略优化（PPO）[Schulman et al., 2017]进行训练，其目标是基于从200个迫近碰撞场景中成对的人类偏好标注学习得到的Bradley-Terry奖励模型[Bradley and Terry, 1952]。结果显示，在人类监督下，规范性伦理框架的可学习性存在不对称性。康德主义条件在码本下简化为一个恒定预测任务，作为管线控制手段：它证实了训练稳定性，并排除了基础设施故障是功利主义结果成因的可能性。而功利主义智能体学到了更令人不安的内容：人类评分者更倾向于奖励自我牺牲而非伤亡最小化，并且模型忠实地学习了这一偏好。这种人类在理论上所规定与其在实践中给予奖励之间的偏差表明，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）所学到的并非哲学家所定义的伦理，而是人类实际践行的伦理。

title: Semantic- and Density-Aware Planning for Accessibility-Preserving Multi-Object Placement
summary: Long-term manipulation planning requires robots to reason not only about immediate task success but also about how current decisions affect future interactions with the environment. In this context, household service robots may need to organize groceries in partially occupied shelves while using limited storage space efficiently and preserving access for subsequent placements. In this paper, we consider an online multi-object shelf-placement setting in which future objects arrivals are unknown. Existing approaches do not jointly address semantic organization, dense space utilization, and manipulator accessibility during sequential shelf filling. To address this gap, we propose Semantic-Dense Placement Planning (SDPP), an accessibility-preserving approach that ranks candidate poses using a semantic-density score combining inter-object semantic similarity with spatial proximity. An Accessibility Map (AM) further filters candidates unlikely to be reachable before motion planning and penalizes placements that reduce the remaining accessible workspace. Simulation experiments show that SDPP significantly improves semantic placement quality over state-of-the-art baselines and achieves the highest average shelf density, while the AM substantially reduces the time required to identify feasible placement poses. A qualitative real-world experiment demonstrates the applicability of our pipeline in a domestic shelf-storage scenario.
tldr: This paper introduces Semantic-Dense Placement Planning (SDPP), an online multi-object shelf-placement method that jointly optimizes semantic organization, spatial density, and manipulator accessibility using a combined pose ranking score and an Accessibility Map filter.
tldr_zh: 本文提出语义-密集放置规划(SDPP)，通过结合语义相似性与空间接近性的评分以及可访问性地图过滤，在在线多物体货架放置中联合优化语义组织、空间利用率和机械臂可达性。
summary_zh: 长期操控规划要求机器人不仅需要考虑当前任务的成败，还需评估当前决策对未来与环境交互的影响。在此背景下，家庭服务机器人可能需要在部分已占用的货架上整理杂货，同时高效利用有限存储空间并保留后续放置的可操作性。本文针对未来物品到达顺序未知的在线多物体货架放置问题展开研究。现有方法在连续货架填充过程中无法协同处理语义组织、密集空间利用与机械臂可达性三大需求。为填补这一空白，我们提出语义密集放置规划（SDPP），这是一种保留可达性的方法，通过融合物体间语义相似度与空间邻近性的语义密度评分对候选位姿进行排序。进一步地，可达性地图（AM）可在运动规划前过滤掉难以到达的候选位姿，并对缩减剩余可达工作空间的放置行为施加惩罚。仿真实验表明，SDPP在语义放置质量上显著优于当前最优基线方法，并实现了最高平均货架密度；而AM则大幅缩短了可行放置位姿的识别时间。定性真实世界实验验证了本方法在家庭货架存储场景中的适用性。

title: Design Optimization for Large High-Force Soft Robot Manipulators Under Gravitational Loads
summary: Designing large soft robots capable of generating high forces for physical human-robot interaction remains a significant challenge in soft robotics. Prior work in large soft robots has focused on proof-of-concept prototypes, and no systematic framework exists for determining the suitability of a design paradigm for a desired task. This manuscript introduces a method for optimizing the geometry of a soft robot limb, maximizing its blocking force subject to an anti-bucking constraint under its own gravitational loading. We demonstrate that an explicit solution exists to the proposed optimization problem under certain assumptions. Experiments with three geometries of a large, soft, pneumatically-actuated manipulator demonstrate that the method correctly predicts which designs meet constraints and which produces the largest end-effector forces. This method, with its closed-form solution, can allow designers to determine a-priori if an intended class of soft manipulators is an appropriate choice for physical interaction at large size scales.
tldr: This paper presents a method for optimizing the geometry of large soft robot limbs to maximize blocking force under gravity while preventing buckling, with a closed-form solution.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种在重力作用下优化大型软机器人肢体几何形状的方法，旨在最大化其阻塞力并避免屈曲，并给出了闭式解。
summary_zh: 设计能够产生高作用力、用于物理性人机交互的大型软体机器人，仍是软体机器人领域的一项重大挑战。此前大型软体机器人的研究主要集中于概念验证原型，目前尚无系统化框架可用于判断某种设计范式对特定任务的适用性。本文提出了一种优化软体机器人肢体几何结构的方法，在考虑自身重力载荷的抗屈曲约束条件下，最大化其锁止力。我们证明了在特定假设条件下，该优化问题存在显式解。通过对三种不同几何结构的大型软体气动操作臂进行实验，验证了该方法能准确预测哪些设计符合约束条件，以及哪种设计能产生最大的末端执行器作用力。该方法的封闭解形式使设计者能够预先判断预期类型的软体操作臂是否适用于大尺度物理交互场景。

title: Co-design of Neural and Muscle Network based on Embodied Perceptron Representation
summary: Recent advances in AI technologies have enabled the advanced design of complex control policies. In contrast, focusing on the body, many robots still employ simple bodies that can limit adaptability to environments. Studies in embodied robotics have shown that well-designed bodies can partially replace the role of control and computation with physical body-environment interactions, yet such designs still depend heavily on expert intuition. There is a need for a systematic theoretical framework for body design, as well as a method for joint optimization of the body and controller. To address this, we introduce the Embodied Perceptron, a theoretical framework that unifies neural networks and physical body systems. In this view, the body itself acts as a perceptron: mechanical parameters correspond to weights, and physical nonlinearities play the role of activation functions. By representing physical constraints as weights and nonlinear properties as activation functions, a physical body can be modeled in neural-network form. The system representation enables us to explicitly and theoretically explain that the body can substitute for part of the neural control. As an application, we co-optimize control policy and muscle configuration in a musculoskeletal robot and show that the resulting embodied intelligence can provide inherent stability, improve learning efficiency, and drastically reduce model size-even with a single-neuron controller. The results bridge the informational and physical worlds and provide a pathway toward understanding and systematic design of embodied AI systems.
tldr: This paper proposes the Embodied Perceptron framework to unify neural networks and physical body design, enabling co-optimization of control policy and muscle configuration in a musculoskeletal robot, achieving inherent stability and reduced model size.
tldr_zh: 本文提出具身感知器框架，统一了神经网络与物理身体设计，实现了肌肉骨骼机器人的控制策略与肌肉配置协同优化，带来了固有稳定性并大幅缩小模型规模。
summary_zh: 摘要：人工智能技术的最新进展使得复杂控制策略的先进设计成为可能。相比之下，在躯体方面，许多机器人仍采用结构简单的躯体，这限制了其对环境的适应能力。具身机器人学研究表明，精心设计的躯体能够通过物理躯体与环境的相互作用，部分替代控制与计算的功能，然而此类设计仍高度依赖专家的直觉。因此，亟需一套系统性的躯体设计理论框架，以及一种能够对躯体与控制器进行联合优化方法。针对这一问题，我们提出了“具身感知器”这一理论框架，将神经网络与物理躯体系统统一起来。在此视角下，躯体本身即扮演感知器的角色：机械参数对应权重，物理非线性特性则发挥激活函数的作用。通过将物理约束表示为权重、将非线性特性表示为激活函数，物理躯体便能够以神经网络形式进行建模。这一系统表征使我们能够从理论上明确解释：躯体可以替代部分神经控制功能。作为应用实例，我们在一个肌肉骨骼机器人上对控制策略与肌肉配置进行了协同优化，结果表明，由此产生的具身智能能够提供内在稳定性、提升学习效率，并大幅缩减模型规模——即使仅使用单神经元控制器亦能实现。该研究结果沟通了信息世界与物理世界，为理解并系统设计具身人工智能系统开辟了路径。

title: Exposing the Long-tail in Embodied Urban Navigation via Scalable Learning from In-the-Wild Videos
summary: Learning embodied urban navigation policies from real-world data is constrained by the cost of task-specific data collection and the limited coverage of rare yet safety-critical scenarios. To address these challenges, we present a scalable framework for learning point-goal urban navigation from web-scale in-the-wild egocentric videos while systematically exposing its long tail. The framework automatically annotates uncurated web videos with metric trajectories and structured navigation semantics, which are then used to train a vision-language-action policy for interpretable navigation planning. We characterize the long tail based on model performance and the distribution of perception-motion patterns, and employ reflection-based analysis to diagnose recurring failure modes. Experiments on web-video data and real-world urban navigation tasks demonstrate effective knowledge transfer from unconstrained videos and reveal coherent long-tail structures beyond aggregate navigation performance.
tldr: A scalable framework that learns point-goal urban navigation policies from web-scale egocentric videos by automatically annotating them with metric trajectories and navigation semantics, then trains a VLA policy that exposes and diagnoses long-tail failure modes.
tldr_zh: 一种可扩展的框架，从网络规模的自我中心视频中学习点目标城市导航策略，通过自动标注度量轨迹和导航语义，训练视觉-语言-动作策略，并暴露和诊断长尾失败模式。
summary_zh: 摘要：从真实世界数据学习具身城市导航策略，受限于特定任务数据采集的高成本以及罕见但关键安全场景的有限覆盖。为解决这些挑战，我们提出一个可扩展框架，通过从网络规模的非受限自我中心视频中学习点目标城市导航，并系统性地暴露其长尾分布。该框架自动为未筛选的网络视频标注度量轨迹和结构化导航语义，进而用于训练可解释导航规划的视觉-语言-动作策略。我们基于模型性能与感知-运动模式的分布来刻画长尾特征，并采用基于反思的分析方法诊断重复性故障模式。在网页视频数据及真实城市导航任务上的实验表明，非受限视频能够实现有效知识迁移，并揭示出超越聚合导航性能的连贯长尾结构。

title: US-VLA: An Ultrasound Vision-Language-Action Model for Embodied Abdomina
summary: Artificial intelligence-assisted ultrasound scanning enhances diagnostic reliability and efficiency by providing real-time guidance for standardized image acquisition and reducing operator dependence. However, existing reinforcement learning and learning-assisted ultrasound scanning methods typically rely on carefully designed reward functions or extensive interaction data, which limits their generalization ability and stability across different devices, patient populations, and complex clinical scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose an ultrasound vision-language-action model (US-VLA) for automated ultrasound scanning that explicitly encodes clinical semantic goals and generates sequential probe manipulation actions under real-time ultrasound feedback. In particular, we first design an ultrasound-aware expert fusion module to jointly integrate ultrasound observations with auxiliary contextual information, enabling semantic ultrasound feedback to effectively guide the scanning process. Then, we construct US-VLA-Data, a real-world dataset covering liver and kidney examinations, which includes five clinically defined standard planes and comprises 320 expert scanning trajectories with approximately 80,000 synchronized timesteps. Extensive experiments demonstrate that US-VLA achieves competitive performance in ultrasound probe manipulation tasks, indicating its effectiveness and promising generalization within the evaluated abdominal ultrasound setting. The source code is available at https://github.com/VMVLab/US-VLA.
tldr: US-VLA introduces a vision-language-action model for automated ultrasound scanning, using an expert fusion module to integrate visual and semantic feedback for sequential probe manipulation, demonstrated on a real-world dataset of liver and kidney exams.
tldr_zh: US-VLA提出了一种用于自动超声扫描的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过专家融合模块整合视觉与语义反馈以生成顺序探头操作，并在肝脏和肾脏检查的真实数据集上验证了有效性。
summary_zh: 人工智能辅助超声扫描通过为标准化图像采集提供实时引导并减少对操作者经验的依赖，显著提升了诊断的可靠性与效率。然而，现有的强化学习及基于学习的超声扫描方法通常依赖于精心设计的奖励函数或大量交互数据，这限制了其在跨设备、跨患者群体及复杂临床场景下的泛化能力与稳定性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种用于自动化超声扫描的超声视觉-语言-动作模型（US-VLA），该模型能够显式编码临床语义目标，并在实时超声反馈下生成序列化的探头操控动作。具体而言，我们首先设计了一种超声感知专家融合模块，将超声观测与辅助上下文信息联合整合，使语义化的超声反馈能有效引导扫描过程。随后，我们构建了涵盖肝脏与肾脏检查的真实世界数据集US-VLA-Data，该数据集包含五种临床定义的标准切面，共320条专家扫描轨迹及约8万个同步时间步。大量实验表明，US-VLA在超声探头操控任务中展现出具有竞争力的性能，验证了其在所评估的腹部超声场景中的有效性及良好的泛化能力。源代码已开源至https://github.com/VMVLab/US-VLA。

title: SCALE: State-Calibrated Latent Embeddings for JEPA Planning in the Right Geometry
summary: Joint-embedding predictive world models plan by scoring predicted terminal embeddings against a goal embedding using a cost defined on the representation itself. Two prominent strategies for obtaining non-collapsed representations are to inherit a pretrained feature space, as in DINO-WM, and to learn an embedding end to end with anti-collapse regularization, as in LeWorldModel (LeWM) with SIGReg. These strategies show complementary strengths across tasks. Although task-relevant state is decodable from the full embeddings of both models, DINO-WM's leading principal components usually retain substantially more state information than LeWM's. Because Euclidean planning costs are dominated by high-variance directions, this difference affects how strongly state can influence candidate selection. We propose SCALE (State-CAlibrated Latent Embeddings) to give the end-to-end LeWM representation the favorable geometric property observed in DINO-WM. SCALE induces this property by correlating sampled pairwise latent distances with distances in a standardized task-relevant state space, without replacing LeWM's learned encoder. Across five tasks, three planning solvers, and five compute budgets, SCALE improves every task--solver average over LeWM. A latent-to-state regression control matches or exceeds SCALE's full-embedding decodability yet leaves latent--state distance alignment essentially unchanged and yields less consistent planning gains. SCALE adds a single lightweight training-time regularizer and no planning-time overhead. These results show that planning depends not only on whether task-relevant information is present, but also on whether it shapes the geometry consumed by the planner.
tldr: SCALE proposes a regularization that aligns the geometry of a learned latent representation with a task-relevant state space, improving planning in joint-embedding predictive world models without adding inference overhead.
tldr_zh: SCALE 提出了一种正则化方法，使学习到的潜在表征的几何结构与任务相关的状态空间对齐，从而在不增加推理开销的情况下改进联合嵌入预测世界模型中的规划性能。
summary_zh: 联合嵌入预测世界模型通过基于表示本身定义的代价函数，将预测的终端嵌入与目标嵌入进行评分来实现规划。获取非坍缩表示的两种主流策略是：继承预训练特征空间（如DINO-WM），以及采用抗坍缩正则化进行端到端嵌入学习（如采用SIGReg的LeWorldModel，简称LeWM）。这两种策略在不同任务中展现出互补优势。尽管任务相关状态可从两种模型的完整嵌入中解码，但DINO-WM的主成分通常比LeWM保留更多状态信息。由于欧几里得规划代价受高方差方向主导，这种差异会影响状态对候选选择的驱动强度。我们提出SCALE（状态校准潜空间嵌入），旨在赋予端到端LeWM表示与DINO-WM相似的有利几何特性。SCALE通过将采样的成对潜空间距离与标准化任务相关状态空间中的距离相关联来诱导该特性，且无需替换LeWM学得的编码器。在五项任务、三种规划求解器及五种计算预算条件下，SCALE在每项任务-求解器组合的平均表现上均优于LeWM。潜空间到状态的回归控制能够匹配甚至超越SCALE的完整嵌入解码能力，但未能实质改变潜空间-状态距离对齐，且规划性能提升的一致性较差。SCALE仅增加了一个轻量级训练时正则化器，且无规划时额外开销。这些结果表明，规划不仅依赖于任务相关信息的存在性，还取决于这些信息是否塑造了规划器所依赖的几何结构。

title: Security of Foundation-Model-Powered Embodied Agents: Attack Surfaces, Attacks, Defenses, and Evaluation
summary: Foundation models are increasingly used for perception, reasoning, planning, and action generation in embodied agents, creating security risks that can propagate from digital inputs to physical behavior. Existing surveys often organize threats by mechanisms such as jailbreaks, prompt injection, backdoors, poisoning, or adversarial examples, but these categories do not consistently identify where an adversary first enters the embodied control loop. We present a trust-boundary-centric survey of foundation-model-powered embodied-agent security. Using a first-compromised-trust-boundary principle, we separate attack surface from attack mechanism and organize the system into five layers and twelve attack surfaces spanning the model supply chain, user instructions, context and memory, physical semantic environments, multimodal perception, world state, internal reasoning, task planning, action interfaces, middleware, multi-agent communication, and execution control. Based on 58 attack records and 61 defense records collected through August 15, 2026, we analyze representative attacks, cross-layer propagation, defense placement, and evaluation practices. Our quantitative analysis shows that attack research is concentrated on multimodal perception and action interfaces, while defenses are especially concentrated on action-level and runtime protection. Context and long-term memory, middleware and networking, world-state integrity, and multi-agent trust remain comparatively underexplored. We conclude with open challenges in state provenance, compositional defenses, long-horizon attack propagation, physical realizability, Byzantine multi-robot behavior, and unified closed-loop evaluation.
tldr: A survey of security threats in foundation-model-powered embodied agents, organized by trust boundaries across five layers and twelve attack surfaces, with quantitative analysis of 58 attacks and 61 defenses.
tldr_zh: 一项关于基于基础模型的具身智能体安全威胁的综述，按五层十二个攻击面的信任边界组织，对58个攻击和61个防御进行了定量分析。
summary_zh: 基础模型日益被用于具身智能体中的感知、推理、规划与动作生成，由此产生的安全风险可从数字输入传播至物理行为。现有综述通常依据越狱攻击、提示注入、后门攻击、数据投毒或对抗样本等机制对威胁进行分类，但这些分类方式未能一致性地识别攻击者首次侵入具身控制回路的切入点。我们提出了一项以信任边界为中心的具身智能体安全综述，该综述由基础模型驱动。基于"首次突破信任边界"原则，我们将攻击面与攻击机制分离，并将系统划分为五个层次与十二个攻击面，涵盖模型供应链、用户指令、上下文与记忆、物理语义环境、多模态感知、世界状态、内部推理、任务规划、动作接口、中间件、多智能体通信及执行控制。基于截至2026年8月15日收集的58条攻击记录与61条防御记录，我们分析了代表性攻击、跨层传播、防御部署及评估实践。定量分析表明，攻击研究集中于多模态感知与动作接口，而防御研究尤其集中于动作层面与运行时保护。上下文与长期记忆、中间件与网络通信、世界状态完整性及多智能体信任领域的研究仍相对不足。最后，我们总结了状态溯源、组合式防御、长期跨步攻击传播、物理可实现性、拜占庭式多机器人行为及统一闭环评估等方向存在的开放性挑战。

title: Adaptive Repulsive Pheromone Clustering for Foraging Robot Swarms
summary: The Central Place Foraging Algorithm (CPFA) combines site fidelity, pheromone-guided navigation, and uninformed random search to enable decentralized resource collection in robot swarms. However, CPFA often revisits previously explored regions while leaving other areas insufficiently searched, reducing efficiency as resources become scarce. In this paper, we propose Adaptive Repulsive Pheromone Clustering (ARPC), a bio-inspired method in which robots deposit repulsive pheromone waypoints to mark previously explored locations. These waypoints are clustered around the nest to estimate low-value search regions, allowing robots to be redirected toward likely unvisited areas. By integrating the exploitation of known resources with systematic avoidance of redundant exploration, ARPC improves search diversity and resource discovery efficiency. Extensive simulations in ARGoS across varying arena sizes, resource densities, and clustered, random, and power-law spatial distributions demonstrate that ARPC consistently outperforms CPFA and the Grid-Based CPFA (GPFA). In particular, ARPC yields significant gains during both early discovery (10\%) and late-stage (up to 60\%) collection, where conventional methods typically degrade. These results indicate that ARPC provides a scalable and robust strategy for large-scale heterogeneous swarm foraging environments.
tldr: Proposes Adaptive Repulsive Pheromone Clustering (ARPC), a bio-inspired foraging algorithm that uses repulsive pheromone waypoints to avoid redundant exploration and improve resource collection efficiency in robot swarms, outperforming baselines in simulation.
tldr_zh: 提出自适应排斥性信息素聚类（ARPC）算法，通过使用排斥性信息素路径点标记已探索区域，避免冗余搜索，提高机器人蜂群觅食效率，在仿真中优于基线方法。
summary_zh: 中心地点觅食算法（CPFA）结合了场所忠诚度、信息素引导导航与非信息随机搜索，使机器人集群能够实现去中心化的资源采集。然而，CPFA常会重复搜索已探索区域，导致其他区域搜索不足，在资源稀缺时效率下降。本文提出自适应排斥信息素聚类（ARPC），这是一种仿生方法：机器人通过设置排斥性信息素路径点来标记已探索区域，这些路径点围绕巢穴聚类形成低价值搜索区域估计值，从而引导机器人转向可能未访问的区域。通过将已知资源开发与冗余探索的系统性规避相结合，ARPC提升了搜索多样性与资源发现效率。在ARGoS平台上的大量仿真实验表明，无论场地规模、资源密度及资源呈现聚集型、随机型或幂律分布时，ARPC始终优于CPFA与基于网格的CPFA（GPFA）。特别值得注意的是，在传统方法性能下降的早期发现阶段（资源收集量达10%）与后期阶段（资源收集量达60%），ARPC均能取得显著增益。这些结果表明，ARPC为大规模异构集群觅食环境提供了一种可扩展且鲁棒的策略。

title: When State Becomes an Attack Surface: State-Semantic Injection in LLM-Driven Embodied Agents
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated capabilities in in-context learning, task decomposition, step-by-step reasoning, and code generation, driving their gradual evolution from text generation models into the core of agents capable of perceiving environments, invoking tools, and executing tasks. Traditional LLM Agents typically obtain information through webpages, documents, databases, or external tools and generate corresponding invocation sequences according to user goals; when this technology is further integrated with robotic systems, large language models begin to undertake functions such as task understanding, high-level planning, and behavioral decision-making. SayCan combines the task reasoning capability of language models with the affordances of robotic skills, while Code as Policies and ProgPrompt generate robot task plans through policy code and programmatic prompting, respectively, and VoxPoser uses language models and vision-language models to construct three-dimensional value maps to guide robotic manipulation \cite{6,7,8,9}. Vision-language-action models such as PaLM-E, RT-2, and GR00T N1 further strengthen the connection among language, visual perception, and robotic actions \cite{10,11,12}.
